purpose: Machine-readable county custodian routing and request tracking scaffold for Indiana official 2024 precinct/subcounty President and U.S. Senate follow-through.
sourceAuthorities: Indiana Election Division ENR JurR county jurisdiction JSON captures
Indiana Election Division statewide county precinct/split count PDF
routingPolicy: Ask the Indiana Election Division for a statewide machine-readable export first.
Use county rows only as custodian follow-up if the state confirms no statewide export exists.
Treat counties with at least 100 precincts or at least 30 precinct splits as high-volume/split follow-up priorities.

stateRequestEvidence.finding: Official retained ENR President and U.S. Senate category files expose 92 county/locality regions each, while the collected JurR files rescan to zero candidate containers.

The official statewide precinct-count PDF reports 5,147 precincts, 1,342 precinct splits, and 1,092 precincts with splits, so local-result requests must preserve precinct-split and reporting-mode identifiers.

Generated request packet asks for President and U.S. Senate rows at the same reporting-unit grain, field definitions, manifests, certification/finality status, and reconciliation back to official ENR county totals.

parserRequirements: One row per contest, county, local reporting unit, precinct split if applicable, candidate, party, and vote mode if modes are provided.
Stable county/FIPS plus reporting-unit identifiers are required; display labels alone are not sufficient because precinct names may be duplicated or split.
A manifest must identify whether each county file contains precinct rows, precinct-split rows, vote-center/reporting-unit rows, absentee/early/provisional rows, or summary rows.
President and U.S. Senate imports must use the same local keys before replacing MIT/OpenElections supplemental review rows.
Importer validation must reconcile local President and U.S. Senate totals to the official ENR county category totals before any source caveat is relaxed.
caveat: This is an operational request tracker only. It does not contain candidate result rows and does not replace official ENR county results or supplemental review caveats.
